Rust JavaScript package manager
Usage: jsm [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]
Commands:
  init     
  add      
  install  
  remove   
  run      
  exec     
  list     
  why      
  config   
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
Options:
      --cwd <CWD>              [default: .]
      --json                   
      --quiet                  
      --verbose                
      --offline                
      --prefer-offline         
      --store-dir <STORE_DIR>  
      --registry <REGISTRY>    
      --no-color               
      --non-interactive        
      --config <CONFIG>        
      --trace <FILE>           Write a Chrome trace for diagnostic runs
  -h, --help                   Print help
  -V, --version                Print version
